decisions.decision: git mv the charge_gaps migration file into analytics dir; no new migration, no DDL, no data copy.
decisions.why: goose keys applied-ness by version in one shared table across dirs, so neither dir re-runs it. The DROP+CREATE shape would lose the data, since MIGRATIONS_DIRS runs telemetry before analytics.

decisions.decision: The GapWriter port moves as-is to analytics; cmd/poller keeps its two-step shape. Collapsing into Recalculate was rejected.
decisions.why: Keeps the tier a pure ownership move. The metrics/gaps divergence on a step-2 error is pre-existing and deliberately untouched, documented so the reviewer does not read it as a regression.

decisions.decision: MissingChargingType moves to analytics; gateway history.go re-points its import.
decisions.why: The enum follows the data. telemetry ends with zero references; analytics stops importing telemetry for a label about its own data.

decisions.decision: Treated the database design gate as SATISFIED by the owner interview rather than re-asking.
decisions.why: The owner confirmed I1-I3 directly before artifacts existed, and design.md declares no DDL - verified: sqlc.yaml scopes schema per module dir, so the atomic-move constraint is real.

decisions.decision: Leader ran git add -A while a worker was writing, sweeping draft T5 artifacts into the suite-run commit; amended the message to say so rather than rewriting history.
decisions.why: Nothing lost, branch unpushed. A commit that misdescribes its own contents is worse than an untidy one. Staging explicit paths from here.

decisions.decision: Owner re-granted, in this session, autopilot + permission for the assistant to run the test suite ("Full permissions. I'm sleeping").

decisions.decision: Batched wave 3 + wave 4 into two module dispatches (analytics: 3.1+4.2; telemetry: 3.2+4.1) instead of four.
decisions.why: 3.2 depends on 3.1 and 4.1 on 3.2, so the modules must run serially anyway; one dispatch per module reads the doc pack once.

decisions.decision: Reworded docs' internal/charging isolation claim to cite its closed Allowed-Imports allowlist instead of adding internal/analytics to charging's forbidden list.
decisions.why: The forbidden list names telemetry, not analytics, so the claim went stale when GapWriter moved. Editing a third module widens a change the owner scoped narrow (I2). Logged as backlog item 14.
